## About

Joey is a software developer with 6+ years of experience (since December 2019) specializing in scalable front-end engineering and UX/UI product design. He bridges the gap between design and engineering — taking products from MVP to scale.

## Skills & Expertise

- **Software Development**: Building scalable web and mobile applications, translating business requirements into technical solutions
- **Team Leadership**: Cross-functional coordination, managed teams of ~30 people
- **Product Management**: Unblocking dependencies, aligning stakeholders, defining roadmaps
- **UX Facilitation**: Design-to-code bridging, upskilled 30+ persons, workshop facilitation

## Available For

Senior software engineering roles or strategic consulting engagements.
